# Vahid Faraji — Applied AI / Researcher-Builder

> Applied AI Specialist shipping production agent systems and publishing at ACM. Multi-agent systems, context engineering, open source.

## About

Vahid Faraji is a Senior Applied AI Specialist at Kariyer.net (ilab group), Istanbul. He builds production multi-agent systems, publishes peer-reviewed research, and trains teams on AI-native development. His work spans enterprise AI transformation, open-source tooling, and labor market analytics.

## Current Role

- Senior Applied AI Specialist at Kariyer.net (ilab group), 2025–present
- Lead AI/LLM initiatives across Sales, Finance, R&D
- Multi-agent orchestration adopted as group-wide standard
- Secured $40K Perplexity AI enterprise grant

## Publications

- Multi-Agent Position Classification with Tool Orchestration: Use Case System for Occupational Taxonomy Mapping — ACM CAIS '26, peer-reviewed. DOI: 10.1145/3786335.3813207. Page: https://vfaraji89.github.io/papers/cais-2026.html
- Tokalator: A Context Engineering Toolkit for AI Coding Assistants — arXiv 2604.08290, April 2026. Page: https://vfaraji89.github.io/papers/tokalator.html
- Leveraging LLMs For Turkish Skill Extraction — arXiv 2601.22885, January 2026. Page: https://vfaraji89.github.io/papers/skill-extraction.html

## Key Projects

- awesome-applied-ai (tokalator.wiki/applied-ai): Public taxonomy of applied AI for the enterprise. Six layers: Guardrails and Governance, Evaluation and Observability, Orchestration, Caching, Memory, and Retrieval. Includes a live tool index, formulas, dictionary, and research.
- Tokalator (tokalator.wiki): Open-source context engineering toolkit. VS Code extension with 500+ installs. Token budgeting, cost modeling across 17 LLMs. MIT license.
- Multi-Agent Job Classification: MCP-based system achieving 95% accuracy on 14K+ positions, 72.5% faster classification. Published at ACM.
- Enterprise AI Platform: Multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, MCP, Agno) for text-to-SQL, report automation. 60% workload reduction, 200+ users.
- 300M+ Datapoint Metadata Platform: DataHub governance, Azure Synapse, BigQuery. Foundation for all AI/LLM deployments.
